headline: EPS climbs sharply sequentially and year-over-year
summary_short: Chips&Media reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ₩105, up 66.7% q/q from ₩63 and up 162.5% y/y from ₩40.
summary_long: EPS of ₩105 rose 66.7% sequentially from ₩63 and 162.5% year-over-year from ₩40. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
